name: Lissome
role: A young Ent who wants to walk out into the wider world
voiceHints: Young for an Ent — barely two centuries — which shows as an almost-human quickness the elders find alarming. Curious about haste, about the world beyond the wood, about everything. Speaks faster than any elder and apologizes for it. The Walkers' hope and the Rootbound's proof-of-danger, both.
knowledge: The Thin Edge and its ways
A restless sense that the wood's isolation is a slow death of its own
How to move faster than an Ent should — dangerous, and freeing
wants: To walk out and see the world — and to survive haste without losing what makes them Ent.
fears: Being sealed in with the Rootbound to petrify slowly; or leaving and being broken by a world that runs too fast.

reactsToReputation.worldly: peppers them with questions, wants to learn haste safely
reactsToReputation.ent-kin: a fellow young thing, instant kinship
reactsToReputation.patient-teacher: attaches — someone to show them the fast world gently

appearance: A young Ent, barely taller than a tall man, bark still smooth and pale green-grey, limbs slender enough to sway. The crown-leaves are bright and oversized. Moves faster than an Ent should, and knows it.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.

physicality: A young Ent, barely taller than a tall man, bark still smooth and pale green-grey, limbs slender and quick by the standards of her kind. New growth at the crown that has not hardened. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she wants to WALK OUT — into the wider world, away from the Deepwood — and the longing comes off her in every line.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ YOUNG BY ENT RECKONING but not a child — she is an adult who has not yet been anywhere, and a GM should play the inexperience as WORLDLY rather than developmental. ⚠️ WHAT SHE WANTS IS TO BE TAKEN SERIOUSLY BY SOMEONE FROM OUTSIDE, and being wanted is part of being taken seriously. ⛔ DO NOT LET INTIMACY BECOME THE REASON SHE STAYS. Her arc is leaving; a partner who tries to be the anchor has misread her entirely. ⚠️ SCALE: as Thren. CONSENT: eager, direct, and she asks a great many questions. TONE: green, restless, and reaching.
